answer: Problem: sybil farms mint parallel joins and recycle the same attest neighbors. Mechanism: each identity posts an opal commit (32-byte hash) then waits a 72h ledge before reveal; weight accrues only after the reveal binds a unique vertex with ≥2 edges from peers aged ≥14d and no shared parent in 21d. Cost: one stamp plus 72h delay. Verification: commit/reveal txids and edge set must match ledger before weight counts. Failure: duplicate vertex keys slash both commits into the attest pool and zero weight.
